method: Manual whole-file reading of TreeMap.h (418 lines) and TreeMap.cpp (1151 lines). Initial combined output truncated; cpp reread in three complete ranges. Pinned bytes verified.
findings: DrawTreeMap clears prior geometry before argument handling and uses an explicit stack plus reused child layout scratch. Debug RecurseCheckTree remains recursive and asserts sorted weights and exact aggregate sum; release drawing is not a validation of these invariants.
PrepareRenderArea rejects nonpositive areas and shrinks right/bottom by one. Zero-size root receives a visible root rectangle after background fill, without descending into children.

Rendering can write directly into a selected top-down 32-bit DIB with explicit stride and bounds checks; other DCs use a reusable full-area pixel vector and SetDIBitsToDevice. No measured memory or speed claim.

Hit index uses 16-pixel cells, prefix offsets and one compressed entry vector. Nonterminal items index only border strips when direct-child bounding box and summed area match; otherwise full-parent fallback. Equal area alone does not prove children form a disjoint tiling; normal child layout preconditions remain necessary.
Hit lookup chooses deepest containing indexed candidate. It depends on valid current geometry and normal nested partitions; this increment does not execute original hit-test runtime controls.

MakeBrightColor divides by the sum of input RGB channels without a zero-color guard, then converts results to integer. For black this expression is nonfinite; actual reachable GUI call with black and resulting Windows behavior remain unqualified. SetOptions clamps saturation only, relying on upstream validation for other numeric parameters.

Folder color cache has 4096 direct-mapped slots but a separate branch map that can grow with folders; fixed slot count does not bound all color-cache memory. ClearLayout retains capacities; TrimMemory swaps layout and pixel containers.
Cushion shading dispatches parallel row processing only at >=512K pixels, width>=256 and height>=64. This threshold and scheduler comment do not establish speedup on this host.

Extension labels skip small rectangles, cache measured extents per draw and optionally sample bitmap center for contrast. Theme text prefers contrast >=3:1; this is not a claim of complete accessibility compliance.
limits: No Windows build, rendering, boundary runtime, numerical sanitizer, hit-index property tests or performance measurement in this increment.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred. Global completed repository count remains 147/500.
